title: Marvel
subtitle: Cinematic Universe
description: The complete Marvel Cinematic Universe in release order.

movies.title: Eyes of Wakanda
movies.synopsis: Across centuries of hidden history, Wakandan warriors known as the Hatut Zeraze undertake dangerous missions around the world to recover stolen Vibranium artifacts and protect Wakanda's greatest secret.

movies.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
movies.synopsis: During World War II, Steve Rogers transforms from a determined young soldier into Captain America, becoming the world's first Super Soldier as he battles the Red Skull and Hydra to stop a powerful new weapon.

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: Agent Carter
movies.synopsis: One year after the end of World War II, Peggy Carter takes on a dangerous solo mission that could change the future of the Strategic Scientific Reserve.

movies.title: Captain Marvel
movies.synopsis: After an elite Kree warrior crash-lands on Earth, Carol Danvers begins uncovering the truth about her past, leading her to embrace extraordinary powers that will shape the future of the galaxy.

movies.title: Iron Man
movies.synopsis: After being captured while demonstrating his latest weapons, billionaire inventor Tony Stark builds a powerful suit of armor to escape and begins a journey that will redefine his purpose as Iron Man.

movies.title: Iron Man 2
movies.synopsis: As Tony Stark faces mounting pressure from the government and powerful new enemies, he must confront the consequences of revealing his identity while searching for a way to secure the future of Iron Man.

movies.title: The Incredible Hulk
movies.synopsis: While searching for a cure to the gamma radiation that transformed him into the Hulk, Bruce Banner must stay one step ahead of the military as a powerful new threat emerges.

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
movies.synopsis: On his way to New Mexico, S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Phil Coulson makes an unexpected stop at a remote gas station, where a routine errand quickly turns into a dangerous encounter.

movies.title: Thor
movies.synopsis: After his arrogance reignites an ancient conflict, the mighty Thor is stripped of his powers and exiled to Earth, where he must learn what it truly means to be worthy before a dangerous threat reaches both worlds.

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: The Consultant
movies.synopsis: Agents Phil Coulson and Jasper Sitwell devise an unconventional plan to keep a dangerous individual away from the Avengers Initiative.

movies.title: The Avengers
movies.synopsis: When an unexpected threat puts Earth in jeopardy, Nick Fury assembles a remarkable team of heroes who must learn to work together to save the world.

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: Item 47
movies.synopsis: Two ordinary civilians discover abandoned Chitauri technology after the Battle of New York, drawing the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D.

movies.title: Thor: The Dark World
movies.synopsis: Thor reunites with Jane Foster as an ancient force threatens the Nine Realms, forcing him to confront a powerful enemy from Asgard's past.

movies.title: Iron Man 3
movies.synopsis: Still haunted by recent events, Tony Stark faces a mysterious terrorist whose attacks push him to rely on his ingenuity more than ever before.

movies.title: Marvel One-Shot: All Hail the King
movies.synopsis: A documentary filmmaker visits Seagate Prison to interview Trevor Slattery, but unexpected visitors have plans of their own.

movies.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
movies.synopsis: As Steve Rogers adjusts to the modern world, he uncovers a conspiracy that threatens S.H.I.E.L.D. and forces him to question who he can trust.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
movies.synopsis: A group of unlikely outlaws must work together after stealing a mysterious artifact that powerful forces will stop at nothing to obtain.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
movies.synopsis: While exploring Peter Quill's mysterious origins, the Guardians discover that family can be both a source of strength and great danger.

movies.title: I Am Groot
movies.synopsis: Baby Groot embarks on a series of delightful adventures across the galaxy, meeting unusual creatures and finding trouble in the smallest places.

movies.title: I Am Groot Season 2
movies.synopsis: Groot returns for another collection of lighthearted adventures that showcase his curiosity, bravery, and unique charm.

movies.title: Daredevil
movies.synopsis: Blind lawyer Matt Murdock fights for justice by day and protects Hell's Kitchen by night as the masked vigilante Daredevil.

movies.title: Jessica Jones
movies.synopsis: A private investigator with extraordinary abilities is forced to confront the traumatic past she has spent years trying to escape.

movies.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
movies.synopsis: When an ambitious peacekeeping program goes terribly wrong, Earth's Mightiest Heroes must unite against a powerful new enemy of their own making.

movies.title: Ant-Man
movies.synopsis: Master thief Scott Lang gains an extraordinary suit that allows him to shrink in size while increasing in strength, giving him a chance at redemption.

movies.title: Daredevil Season 2
movies.synopsis: New allies and dangerous enemies challenge Matt Murdock as Hell's Kitchen becomes more dangerous than ever.

movies.title: Luke Cage
movies.synopsis: After a failed experiment leaves him with unbreakable skin and superhuman strength, Luke Cage becomes an unlikely hero in Harlem.

movies.title: Iron Fist
movies.synopsis: Danny Rand returns to New York after years away, determined to reclaim his family's legacy while mastering the mystical power of the Iron Fist.

movies.title: The Defenders
movies.synopsis: New York's street-level heroes unite to confront a powerful organization that threatens the city.

movies.title: Captain America: Civil War
movies.synopsis: Political pressure divides the Avengers, forcing friends to choose sides as an internal conflict threatens to tear the team apart.

movies.title: Black Widow
movies.synopsis: Natasha Romanoff confronts unfinished business from her past when a dangerous conspiracy forces her back into the world she tried to leave behind.

movies.title: Black Panther
movies.synopsis: Returning home to Wakanda as king, T'Challa faces challenges that test his leadership and the future of his nation.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
movies.synopsis: Eager to prove himself as a hero, Peter Parker balances everyday life with the opportunity to become something greater.

movies.title: The Punisher
movies.synopsis: Frank Castle uncovers a military conspiracy while seeking justice for the loss of his family.

movies.title: Doctor Strange
movies.synopsis: A brilliant surgeon discovers a hidden world of mystic arts after a life-changing accident sends him on an unexpected path.

movies.title: Jessica Jones Season 2
movies.synopsis: Jessica investigates the origins of her extraordinary abilities while confronting painful truths from her past.

movies.title: Luke Cage Season 2
movies.synopsis: Luke struggles with the responsibilities of being Harlem's protector as new threats challenge his values.

movies.title: Iron Fist Season 2
movies.synopsis: Danny Rand continues protecting New York while facing enemies connected to his past and the legacy of the Iron Fist.

movies.title: Daredevil Season 3
movies.synopsis: Broken in body and spirit, Matt Murdock must rise once again to protect Hell's Kitchen from an old enemy.

movies.title: Thor: Ragnarok
movies.synopsis: Imprisoned far from Asgard, Thor races against time to prevent the destruction of his home and stop a powerful new ruler.

movies.title: The Punisher Season 2
movies.synopsis: Frank Castle is drawn into another deadly conflict while protecting a young girl from dangerous enemies.

movies.title: Jessica Jones Season 3
movies.synopsis: Jessica Jones faces one final investigation as a brilliant and dangerous adversary threatens everything she stands for.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
movies.synopsis: Scott Lang teams up with Hope van Dyne on a mission that uncovers long-buried secrets while pushing their shrinking technology to new limits.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War
movies.synopsis: The Avengers and their allies unite against a cosmic warlord determined to gather artifacts of unimaginable power before it's too late.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.synopsis: After a devastating defeat, Earth's Mightiest Heroes embark on a desperate mission that could restore hope and change the fate of the universe forever.

movies.title: Loki
movies.synopsis: After escaping with the Tesseract, Loki is drawn into a mysterious organization that exists beyond time itself.

movies.title: What If...?
movies.synopsis: Watch familiar moments from across the Marvel Universe unfold in surprising new ways as alternate realities reshape history.

movies.title: Marvel Zombies
movies.synopsis: In a universe overrun by the undead, a handful of survivors fight to stay alive against terrifying versions of Earth's Mightiest Heroes.

movies.title: WandaVision
movies.synopsis: Wanda Maximoff and Vision begin an idyllic suburban life that slowly reveals unsettling mysteries hiding beneath the surface.

movies.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
movies.synopsis: A skilled martial artist is forced to confront his past when he becomes entangled with the mysterious Ten Rings organization.

movies.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
movies.synopsis: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes join forces on a global mission that challenges their partnership and the legacy of Captain America.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
movies.synopsis: Peter Parker hopes for a normal school trip across Europe, but unexpected responsibilities force him back into action.

movies.title: Eternals
movies.synopsis: Immortal heroes who have secretly protected Earth for thousands of years reunite when an ancient threat emerges once again.

movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.synopsis: Doctor Strange ventures into the Multiverse where impossible realities force him to confront powerful new dangers.

movies.title: Hawkeye
movies.synopsis: Clint Barton teams up with a gifted young archer while trying to leave his past behind before the holidays.

movies.title: Moon Knight
movies.synopsis: A quiet museum employee discovers he shares his body with a mysterious mercenary connected to the gods of ancient Egypt.

movies.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
movies.synopsis: As Wakanda mourns the loss of its king, old and new threats challenge the nation's future and force its leaders to unite.

movies.title: Echo
movies.synopsis: Maya Lopez returns to her hometown, where confronting her past becomes the key to defining her future.

movies.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
movies.synopsis: Lawyer Jennifer Walters unexpectedly gains Hulk-like abilities while trying to balance a demanding legal career with extraordinary new responsibilities.

movies.title: Ms. Marvel
movies.synopsis: Teenager Kamala Khan discovers mysterious powers that transform her lifelong dream of becoming a superhero into reality.
movies.director: Adil El Arbi & Bilall Fallah, Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy

movies.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
movies.synopsis: Thor embarks on a new journey of self-discovery, but a dangerous new enemy forces him back into battle alongside unexpected allies.

movies.title: Ironheart
movies.synopsis: Young genius Riri Williams pushes her incredible inventions to the next level while confronting powerful forces beyond science.

movies.title: Werewolf by Night
movies.synopsis: A secret gathering of monster hunters takes a deadly turn as an ancient relic draws out hidden rivalries and terrifying creatures.

movies.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
movies.synopsis: The Guardians set out on a heartfelt mission to bring Peter Quill an unforgettable Christmas celebration on Earth.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
movies.synopsis: Scott Lang and his family are pulled into the mysterious Quantum Realm, where they encounter a powerful new adversary.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
movies.synopsis: The Guardians embark on a dangerous mission to save one of their own while confronting painful truths about Rocket's past.

movies.title: Secret Invasion
movies.synopsis: Nick Fury returns to Earth after uncovering a covert invasion that threatens humanity from within.

movies.title: The Marvels
movies.synopsis: Carol Danvers, Kamala Khan, and Monica Rambeau discover their powers have become mysteriously linked, forcing them to fight as one.

movies.title: Loki Season 2
movies.synopsis: Loki races against time across the multiverse to protect the fragile balance of reality itself.

movies.title: What If...? Season 2
movies.synopsis: New alternate realities reveal unexpected heroes, villains, and possibilities across the Marvel Multiverse.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.synopsis: Deadpool is pulled into a mission that forces him to team up with a reluctant Wolverine, sending both on a multiversal adventure.

movies.title: Agatha All Along
movies.synopsis: Agatha Harkness sets out on a magical journey that reveals new allies, dangerous enemies, and long-buried secrets.

movies.title: What If...? Season 3
movies.synopsis: The Watcher returns to explore even more alternate realities where familiar heroes face extraordinary new destinies.

movies.title: Daredevil: Born Again
movies.synopsis: Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk find themselves on a collision course as old rivalries reignite in a changed New York City.

movies.title: Captain America: Brave New World
movies.synopsis: Sam Wilson faces an international crisis that tests his leadership and the meaning of carrying Captain America's shield.

movies.title: Thunderbolts*
movies.synopsis: A group of unlikely antiheroes is brought together for a dangerous mission that will test their loyalty and redefine their future.

movies.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
movies.synopsis: Marvel's First Family begins a new adventure as they face extraordinary challenges that could reshape their future.

movies.title: Daredevil: Born Again Season 2
movies.synopsis: Matt Murdock's fight for justice continues as new threats emerge across Hell's Kitchen.

movies.title: Wonder Man
movies.synopsis: Struggling actor Simon Williams unexpectedly finds himself thrust into a world where fame and superpowers collide.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.synopsis: Four years after the events of No Way Home, Peter Parker continues protecting New York while confronting dangerous new threats and the consequences of living a life no one remembers.

movies.title: Avengers: Doomsday
movies.synopsis: As powerful forces from across the Multiverse collide, Earth's Mightiest Heroes and unexpected allies must unite to face a threat unlike any they have encountered before.
